title: evidence_record
description: One inspectable number or fact behind a result (BUILD_BRIEF section 6). An explanation statement is valid only if the records it cites have the right metric, subject, unit and period for what it says: matching the digits is not enough. label: FACT = taken unchanged from a cited source or from a confirmed policy record; ASSUMPTION = a modelling choice; FICTIONAL_SCENARIO = invented for the simulation (persona weights, scenario thresholds, the hypothetical purchase); CALCULATION = computed by the engine from the records in derived_from.

value.description: Number for numeric units; string for unit 'date' or 'text'; null only when the value could not be computed.

unit.description: 'fraction' for every weight, exposure, limit, return and gap. Never a percentage.

id.description: instrument_id, issuer_id, fund_id, rule_id, 'USDCAD' for FX, or the portfolio_id.

via_fund_id.description: The fund through which an issuer figure arises (fund_constituent_weight, issuer_exposure_via_fund); otherwise null.

portfolio_state.description: STARTING = before the purchase; PROPOSED = after it; NOT_APPLICABLE for source facts.

source_ids.description: Sources in sources.json. May be empty only for FICTIONAL_SCENARIO and ASSUMPTION records and for CALCULATION records that list derived_from.

derived_from.description: evidence_ids this value was computed from (the calculation path). Empty for non-CALCULATION records.

formula.description: Template-rendered formula with the numbers used, for CALCULATION records; otherwise null.

policy_version.description: Policy version the result was computed under; null in a preview (draft thresholds).
